tools.name: list_studio_options
tools.title: List studio options
tools.description: Discovery call: the image, video and upscaler models available in the studio with their allowed aspect ratios and sizes, plus the prompt presets. Call this before generate_image or upscale_media to pick valid values.

tools.name: write_prompt
tools.title: Write a prompt (Prompt Generator)
tools.description: Run the studio's Prompt Generator on a brief and get the crafted image prompt back. Pass the whole conversation so far in `messages` to iterate. The result can be fed straight into generate_image.

brief.description: The brief or instruction. Shortcut for a single user message.

messages.description: Full conversation so far (newest last). Use instead of `brief` for follow-ups.

reference_image_urls.description: Public https URLs of reference images to describe alongside the brief.

skill.description: Prompt Generator skill key, e.g. 'brief-to-prompt'. Defaults to brief-to-prompt.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.title: Generate images
tools.description: Run an image generation in the studio exactly as the app does: a prompt, a model, aspect ratio, size, how many variations, and optional reference image URLs. Returns download URLs for the finished images. Use list_studio_options first for valid model ids, aspect ratios and sizes.

prompt.description: The full image prompt / brief to render.

model.description: Model id from list_studio_options, e.g. 'nano-banana-pro'. Defaults to nano-banana-pro.

size.description: Size or quality tier the model allows, e.g. '1K', '2K', '1536x1024'.

reference_image_urls.description: Public https URLs of reference images to condition on.

session_id.description: Session to record the run in. Omit to use the caller's default session.

tools.name: upscale_media
tools.title: Upscale an image or video
tools.description: Send an image or video to the studio's upscaler and get the enhanced file back. Source can be a public URL or an asset id from list_assets. Videos and 4x/6x image jobs can outlast the call — you then get a turn_id to poll with check_run.

source_url.description: Public https URL of the image or video to upscale.

source_asset_id.description: Asset id from list_assets to upscale instead of a URL.

model.description: Upscale model id from list_studio_options. Defaults to topaz-image-upscale / topaz-video-upscale.

session_id.description: Session to record the run in.

tools.name: check_run
tools.title: Check a run
tools.description: Check a generation or upscale run by its turn_id and collect the finished files. Use this when generate_image or upscale_media returned status 'running'.

turn_id.description: The turn id returned by generate_image or upscale_media.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.title: List recent assets
tools.description: List the caller's recent studio images and videos with download URLs and asset ids — useful for picking an upscale source or re-sending a reference.

limit.description: How many assets to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.
